entities.name: Adrian Kivumbi Ddungu
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Adrian Kivumbi Ddungu was a Ugandan Catholic priest who served as the second bishop of the Diocese of Masaka, in Uganda, from 11 November 1961 until 10 January 1998.
